fixtures.description: Bloomberg CDSW clean Principal / Def Exposure versus Finstack dirty economic NPV

metrics.reason: MODELS-AND-VALUATIONS-CREDIT-12 and CREDIT-13 define CDS economic NPV as dirty PV without adding back settlement accrued premium, whereas Bloomberg CDSW Principal is clean NPV (dirty PV plus accrued). The Bloomberg CDSW target and its tolerance are preserved.
metrics.evidence: Finstack dirty npv is -194217.1276 versus Bloomberg CDSW Principal -181992.0 (diff -12225.13, unchanged tolerance USD 6). Adding back the 44-day inclusive ACT/360 accrued premium (2026-03-20 to 2026-05-02, 44/360 * 0.01 * 10MM = 12222.2222) gives clean NPV -181994.91, leaving a USD 2.91 residual inside the USD 6 tolerance.

metrics.reason: DefaultExposure computes signed LGD payout minus economic NPV (MODELS-AND-VALUATIONS-CREDIT-12/-13), so it inherits the exact clean-versus-dirty accrued convention shift relative to Bloomberg CDSW Def Exposure (LGD minus Principal). The Bloomberg target and its tolerance are preserved.
metrics.evidence: Finstack default_exposure is 6194217.1276 (6000000 - (-194217.1276)) versus Bloomberg CDSW Def Exposure 6181992.0 (diff +12225.13, unchanged tolerance USD 6); subtracting the USD 12222.2222 accrued premium gives 6181994.91, leaving a USD 2.91 residual inside the USD 6 tolerance.

fixtures.description: Bloomberg SWPM BR01 versus the factor-native projection-curve bump

metrics.reason: Bloomberg BR01 moves the 3M Term SOFR forward by 1bp. Finstack bumps a forward curve by a continuous 1bp parallel shift of its projection factors on the curve's ACT/360 clock, which moves the simple 92-day forward by (1 + F*tau) bp. The convention gap is not a pricing defect, so the Bloomberg target and its tolerance are preserved.
metrics.evidence: Finstack -253.9589 versus Bloomberg -251.51 (ratio 1.00974). Scaling Bloomberg by 1 + 0.036437 * 92/360 = 1.009312 gives -253.852; the remaining 0.107 is inside the fixture's unchanged USD 0.15 calibrated-discount-curve tolerance.
